source.author: verg
source.text: Quos bonus Aeneas haud aspernanda precantis prosequitur venia et verbis haec insuper addit:
source.text_original: Quos bonus Aeneas haud aspernanda precantis / prosequitur venia et verbis haec insuper addit: /
source.text_english: Good Aeneas follows those who beg with a pardon not to be scorned, and adds these words besides:

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: quid quod bonus Aeneas haut aspernanda precantis trucidauit?
reuse.text_original: quid quod bonus Aeneas haut aspernanda precantis trucidauit?
reuse.text_english: What of the fact that good Aeneas slaughtered suppliants who were by no means to be scorned?
